workspace_tmp: $TMPDIR (per-run scratch directory; the absolute path is deliberately not published)
method: https://ai-sdk.dev/llms.txt (single vendor corpus, HTTP 200, 4,937,216 bytes) split into per-page markdown files by the page delimiter; npm dist-tags via registry.npmjs.org/-/package/ai/dist-tags; repo metadata via authenticated `gh api repos/vercel/ai`. Every source excerpt is asserted to be an exact substring of the saved file before the brief is written.
not_executed: provider or model calls: no API key was used, so no token was generated and no response was streamed
runtime execution, bundler build, React render or Next.js app (only tsc --noEmit)
runtime behaviour of the legacy ai/react surface (the tsc errors stop the check, so no runtime assertion is made)
